## Executive Summary
Added authentication guards to all protected API routes (34 routes) to prevent unauthorized access. Three public routes (health check and RSS feeds) were documented as intentionally unprotected.

## Auth Guard Implementation

### Pattern Applied
```typescript
import { requireAuth } from '@/lib/auth-guard'

export async function GET() {
  const auth = await requireAuth()
  if (!auth.authorized) return auth.error!

  // Handler continues...
}
```

### Protected Routes (34 total)
All routes except health and RSS feeds now require:
1. Valid Supabase session via SSR cookies
2. User email in ALLOWED_EMAILS list (`brownpr0@gmail.com`)

### Public Routes (3 total)
- `/api/health` - Health monitoring (documented)
- `/api/rss/daily-digest` - Public RSS feed (documented)
- `/api/rss/ai-tech-digest` - Public RSS feed (documented)
